summary.title: Monthly totals
summary.emptyBody: Add your first income or expense and your totals will appear here.

transaction.amountError: Enter an amount above 0, with up to 2 decimals.

categoryErrors.taken: You already have a category with that name.

activity.perCurrency: Choose a currency to see its totals in Overview. ARS and USD are never added together.
activity.emptyBody: Add your first income or expense and it will appear here.
activity.noResultsBody: Try different filters or another month.

categories.emptyBody: Create one here, or while adding a transaction.

projections.privacy: Your amounts never leave this device. The app only downloads inflation (IPC) factors.
projections.ipcDown: Inflation data is unavailable right now. Costs that increase by IPC are shown without increases until it is back.
projections.customRateError: Enter a rate above 0 and up to {{ max }}, with up to 2 decimals.
projections.ipcNote: IPC increases use official data up to {{ month }} and the chosen estimate for later months.
projections.pickMonthHint: Tap a bar to see that month.
projections.emptyTitle: You have no fixed costs in {{ currency }}.
projections.emptyBody: Add your rent, utilities or subscriptions to see what they will cost in the coming months.

fixedCost.name: Name
fixedCost.ipcHint: Adjusted by the inflation accumulated since the last increase.
fixedCost.lastIncreaseHint: The month it last increased. The next increase is counted from there.

fixedCostErrors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above 0, with up to 2 decimals.
fixedCostErrors.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage above 0 and up to {{ max }}, with up to 2 decimals.
fixedCostErrors.invalidIncreaseAmount: Enter an amount above 0, with up to 2 decimals.
fixedCostErrors.futureLastIncrease: Choose this month or an earlier one.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Everything is stored in this browser. There are no accounts or servers holding your data.
data.storagePersisted: This browser keeps your data even when the device runs out of space.
data.storageNotPersisted: If the device runs out of space, the browser may delete your data.
data.storageDenied: The browser didn't allow it. Installing the app often helps. Until then, export backups often.
data.keepData: Ask the browser to keep it
data.backupBody: If you clear your browser data or change devices, you lose anything you have not exported. Use a backup to move your data to another device.
data.confirmImport: Importing replaces all the data on this device with the data in the file.
data.aboutBody: Inflation (IPC) data comes from INDEC, through a public API that never receives your amounts.
data.dangerBody: Deletes all your data from this device. This cannot be undone.
data.confirmWipe: This deletes every transaction, category and fixed cost on this device. Export a backup first if you may need them.

backupErrors.invalid: This file is not an Expense Tracker backup, or it is damaged. Nothing was changed.
backupErrors.newerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again. Nothing was changed.
backupErrors.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{ size }} MB, so it can't be a backup. Nothing was changed.
